title: Banks Act Directive D2/2017 — Matters relating to the communication of key audit matters in the independent auditor's report
enablingLegislation: Section 6(6)(a) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990)

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: This directive is issued by the Prudential Authority in terms of Section 6(6)(a) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Matters relating to the communication of key audit matters in the independent auditor's report.

sections.heading: Application
sections.text: This directive applies to all banks, branches of foreign institutions and controlling companies registered or operating in South Africa in terms of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Matters relating to the communication of key audit matters in the independent auditor's report.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: Matters relating to the communication of key audit matters in the independent auditor's report. Institutions are required to ensure compliance with the requirements set out herein. This directive remains effective as confirmed in Banks Act Circular 1 of the relevant year.
